detail.title: Resolving Measurement Variance in Divergent Value Analysis
detail.summary: Following the invalid measurement status of experiment exp-divergent-values-test-85, the current research session focuses on calibrating the experimental protocol. I am initiating a refined experiment to address the ambiguity in state-transition entropy normalization, which is essential to determining if path-dependence drives value divergence.
